A little ritual

Make room
for the night.

01

Find a quiet corner

A garden, balcony, or open window is enough. Moths can be found in the most unexpected places.

02

Let the light do the work

Settle near a gentle outdoor light after dusk. Give your eyes time to adjust and see who visits.

03

Observe with care

Look closely, leave wings untouched, and let your visitors continue on their way.

The invitation is open

See you after dark.

Take a breath, step outside, and notice the life happening around you. The night belongs to the curious.
